text: Sales and profit exceed expectations with increased forward guidance driven by sustained semiconductor demand. Capacity expansion accelerates across customers while order disclosure is removed and export restrictions limit access to specific markets.

meta.note: Removal of order data reduces visibility while other metrics remain exposed; dual visibility state present.

text: Earnings, revenue, and credit conditions exceed expectations with improved profitability and upward guidance adjustments. Fixed income underperformance and broader uncertainty remain present within the same operational structure.

meta.note: Alignment and compression coexist; exposure dominates due to mixed internal performance signals.
